writtenCriterion: Support unavailable and partial results everywhere. No component may assume all four market-implied measures, or any Tier 2 output, exists. Each shows the specific reason when absent.
scope: Finite client engineering obligations, not exhaustive combinations or a new scientific/owner acceptance gate. No canonical ledger is modified by this inventory.

retainedDenominator.interpretation: The actual component census and six original passing interactions plus four successful follow-ups remain evidence. Neither original failures nor their follow-ups are rewritten.

obligations.contract: Each withheld physical measure has its own interpretation/reason; available P/E or earnings-yield gaps do not substitute for any physical measure. Legacy fixed-5gt and selected-2024 residual thresholds remain separately labeled.
obligations.rerun: No unchanged41 route harness or all-absent S16-010 rerun.

obligations.contract: Missing nested evidence, undefined eligibility/checks and absent result collections have specific refusal/unavailable reasons, not zero, false approval or a fabricated Tier2 result. Public issuer exports require the selected complete allowlist; private extra keys never become published facts.
obligations.rerun: Preserve the ten interaction receipts; do not rerun the six unchanged passed flows.

obligations.contract: Null/missing/invalid dates are unavailable, never Unix epoch or a guessed date. Dated charts/exports omit undated rows with a visible reason. An undated selected observation cannot establish a latest group headline or derived display-period return accounting; independently available dated values/zeros remain available.

Actual chart series are passed through Recharts with filterNull=false. Missing values display the actual series name plus not-returned reason rather than silently disappearing, bare percent signs or invented zero. Genuine zero keeps its units.

Only current-key supplied evidence is available. Pending/error cannot reuse retained current success, another geography/issuer/archive or its exports. A selected measure with missing fields cannot substitute another measure's present fields. Existing header verification and selected-preview mismatch reasons remain authoritative.

Exports use only current dated rows. Missing numeric cells stay blank/null, actual zero stays zero, and absent/undated rows do not enable a completed download. No invented date or source/selection substitution. Existing public JSON/XLSX allowlist receipts remain unchanged.

notAdditionalAcceptanceRequirements: Every permutation of null/missing/loading/error across every dynamic JSX expression
